title: Reservoir Dogs
about: A jewellery heist goes wrong and the surviving crooks suspect one of them is a cop.
cue: Serve the breakfast when the crew argues about tipping at the diner.
faces: FROM THE DESK OF MR. PINK
Fine, I'll pay for my own burger. But nobody's splitting the bill eight ways, I'm not doing the maths.
